subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled channel human-handoff config surface for WhatsApp DMs, and should that start WhatsApp-first or as a cross-channel contract?
rationale: Source confirms the feature is still missing, but the right API shape, pause-state owner, resume semantics, and cross-channel scope are product/config decisions that code inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve WhatsApp-first plugin-owned handoff
options.body: Implement the personal-number use case in the WhatsApp plugin first with bounded pause state, docs, tests, and live WhatsApp proof before considering Telegram or Discord parity.

options.title: Design a cross-channel handoff contract
options.body: Create a shared channel contract covering WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord, accepting broader API and compatibility review before implementation.

options.title: Keep current static controls
options.body: Treat automatic owner takeover as out of scope for now and keep relying on dmPolicy, allowlists, pairing, and manual operational controls.

recommendation.title: Approve WhatsApp-first plugin-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Implement the personal-number use case in the WhatsApp plugin first with bounded pause state, docs, tests, and live WhatsApp proof before considering Telegram or Discord parity.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily channel/config product direction, and history shows the strongest sustained ownership signal on the affected WhatsApp/config files.
